cards.title: None
cards.description: No special abilities or combat training. Ordinary humans relying on strength, speed, and cleverness.

cards.title: Tailor
cards.description: Uses clothing and thread for offense and defense; disguises, armor, thread traps.

cards.title: Doctor
cards.description: Healing, antidotes, performance-enhancing medicine.

cards.title: Navigator
cards.description: Ocean travel, weather prediction, map-making, ship combat.

cards.title: Covenant Contract
cards.description: Supernatural agreement signed with Imu. Grants immortality, Abyss teleport circle, immense strength; in exchange, free will is lost.

cards.title: Galaxy Impact
cards.description: Cosmic warriors harnessing star/celestial energy for explosive area attacks.

cards.title: Voice of All Things
cards.description: Hears voices of animals, nature, and ancient relics; senses danger; uncovers hidden truths.

cards.title: Armament Haki
cards.description: Spiritual energy armoring body/weapon; can hit Devil Fruit users.

cards.title: Soul Damage Haki
cards.description: Rare advanced Haki that damages souls, bypassing physical defenses.

cards.title: Shipwright
cards.description: Repairs/builds ships mid-battle and develops ship-based weapons.

cards.title: Lily Carnation
cards.description: Symbiotic bond with the Lily Carnation plant; manipulates life forces, reanimates dead.

cards.title: Supreme King Haki
cards.description: Conqueror's Haki: pure willpower that intimidates and subdues weak-minded foes.

cards.title: Life Return
cards.description: Conscious control over body — muscles, bones, recovery, acrobatics.

cards.title: Honestly Impact
cards.description: Fighting style of hard, accurate punches that break guards and stop multiple attackers.

cards.title: Art of Weather
cards.description: Master of sky, sea, and storms via specialized weather staff (Clima-Tact recommended).

cards.title: Colors Trap
cards.description: Painter who manipulates emotions through colored symbols.

cards.title: Weapon Master
cards.description: Multiple weapons (axes, chains, fans) with expert precision.

cards.title: Dragon Claw Fist
cards.description: Hands become dragon claws; Armament-empowered; shatters steel.

cards.title: Eight Impacts Fist
cards.description: Body-vibration shockwaves bypass defenses; unblockable strikes.

cards.title: Black Leg Style
cards.description: Heated leg strikes; flaming kicks, acrobatic combat.

cards.title: Fish Man Jujutsu
cards.description: Close-fighting throws/locks; water-enhanced grappling.

cards.title: Foxfire Style
cards.description: Sword that generates and controls fire; cuts and burns.

cards.title: Six Powers
cards.description: Rokushiki: Iron Body, Moon Walk, Tempest Kick, etc. Superhuman speed and strength.

cards.title: Okama Kenpo
cards.description: Dance-like flashy kicks; flexibility and surprise attacks.

cards.title: Hypnotist
cards.description: Mental manipulation through gestures, voice, and cues.

cards.title: Awakened Devil Fruit
cards.description: Mastered Devil Fruit affecting environment/body extraordinarily.

cards.title: Archaeologist
cards.description: Master of Poneglyphs and lost lore; uncovers ancient weapons.

cards.title: Observation Haki
cards.description: Senses presence, intent, danger before it happens.

cards.title: Full Haki User
cards.description: Mastery of Observation, Armament, and Conqueror's Haki.

cards.title: Gunslinger
cards.description: Long-range; firearms, trick shots, explosives.

cards.title: Swordsman
cards.description: Advanced sword techniques: flying slashes, elemental swordplay.

cards.title: Beast Tamer
cards.description: Commands sea beasts, land animals, mythical Zoans.

cards.title: Cyborg
cards.description: Tech inventor; modifies own body, builds weapons.

cards.title: Brawler
cards.description: Brute force, grapples, wrestling moves.

cards.title: Martial Artist
cards.description: Hand-to-hand styles: Fish-Man Karate, Black Leg, Rokushiki.

cards.title: Spear Fighter
cards.description: Polearm techniques; long-melee, spinning crowd control.

cards.title: Sniper
cards.description: Long-range marksman; rifles, pistols, slingshots.

cards.title: Tactician
cards.description: Commands allies, predicts enemy moves.

cards.title: Poneglyphs Reader
cards.description: Scholar who deciphers indestructible Poneglyph stones.

cards.title: Treasure Hunter
cards.description: Finds loot, deciphers maps, avoids traps.

cards.title: Gadgeteer
cards.description: Smoke bombs, traps, mechanical combat tools.

cards.title: Blacksmith
cards.description: Crafts weapons/armor from Grand Line materials.

cards.title: Professional Cook
cards.description: Master chef whose meals heal/boost allies; combat-ready.

cards.title: Musician
cards.description: Rhythm-based buffs/debuffs; supports allies, confuses enemies.

cards.title: Will of D.
cards.description: Carrier of the D. legacy: unyielding spirit, fearless courage, fated for change.
